texts.about_this_item: Kaskad Classic metal prong collar for behaviour correction and training of dogs. Link thickness 3.5 mm, collar length 55 cm. The links can be removed and put back without effort or special tools. The collar tightens on the slip principle when the lead is pulled; the tightening chain has a quick-release snap hook and a swivel. Made in Russia.
